subject.title: feat(matrix): add configurable read receipt timing

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose configurable Matrix read-receipt timing, including per-account overrides, as a supported public configuration contract?
rationale: The implementation is behaviorally evidenced, but it creates a new operator-facing policy surface and changes validation of existing account configuration; only maintainers can choose the supported long-term contract and upgrade posture.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded Matrix policy
options.body: Keep the three modes with `immediate` as default, but require a plugin-owned Doctor migration and upgrade coverage before merge.

options.title: Keep receipt timing fixed
options.body: Decline the new configuration surface and retain the established immediate-receipt behavior for all Matrix accounts.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded Matrix policy
recommendation.body: Keep the three modes with `immediate` as default, but require a plugin-owned Doctor migration and upgrade coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Matrix delivery and handler work makes this the closest available routing candidate for the channel-level policy decision.
